# Provenance: CACTI 7

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/HewlettPackard/cacti
- **Vendored commit:** `1ffd8dfb10303d306ecd8d215320aea07651e878`
- **License:** HP CACTI research license (see `LICENSE`, preserved from the
  source-file headers; redistribution to third parties who accept the terms is
  permitted, not for sale).

## Which CACTI variant / what it produced

CACTI 7 is the single CACTI variant used by this artifact. The HP `cacti` repo
**is** CACTI 7, which subsumes the CACTI-3DD (DATE'12) 3D-DRAM model — the stored
configs use `-cache type "3D memory or 2D main memory"` plus the `## Parameters
for 3D DRAM` block, i.e. the CACTI-3DD lineage now integrated into CACTI 7. So no
separate CACTI-3DD source is needed.

CACTI 7 produces the **DDR4 / UPMEM** DRAM characterization rows in the PPA DB:

- `data/ppa/cacti_ddr4_results.csv`, generated by
  `data/ppa/generate_dram_lookup_csvs.py`, which templates
  `2DDRAM_micron1Gb.cfg` and invokes `./cacti -infile <cfg>` per DRAM tuple.
  The standard flow generates this CSV at setup
  (`data/ppa/generate_ppa.sh`); the per-run configs + outputs land under
  `data/ppa/lookup_work/dram/` (derived per run, not tracked).
- The SRAM/buffer sweep (`sram_sweep_results.csv`) was produced by the same
  CACTI 7 binary in SRAM (`cache`/`ram`) mode; those run configs were not
  preserved, so that CSV ships as data and only the DRAM characterization is
  generated at setup.

The **HBM / HBM-PIM** DRAM rows (`dreamram_hbm2e_results.csv`) come from DreamRAM
(see `external/dreamram/`), not CACTI.

## Replay verification (version match)

At vendoring time, the vendored binary was replayed on copies of the recorded
per-run characterization configs (fixtures preserved in the artifact's
development history — they no longer ship, since the standard flow now
generates every per-run config under `data/ppa/lookup_work/dram/`), and its
`cacti.cfg.out` was compared to the recorded output:

| recorded config (historical fixture) | verdict |
|---|---|
| `cacti_aspect_h4_b16_v256_c4` | **byte-identical** |
| `cacti_fulliso_h16_b4_v256_c4` | **byte-identical** |
| `cacti_h16_b16_v16_c8` | **values identical** (the recorded file merely repeats the same row 4× from multiple generator invocations; the data row matches exactly) |

**Verdict: exact match.** CACTI 7 @ `1ffd8df` is the correct version that
produced the recorded DDR4 lookup outputs — no version mismatch.

## Local modifications

Two guards were added in `io.cc` (both marked `PNMAX-AE patch`). The stored
configs model 3D-DRAM / 2D-main-memory and deliberately do **not** set the
CACTI-IO / DIMM parameters (`num_dq`, `mem_data_width`, `num_clk`). Stock CACTI 7
runs two *diagnostic-only* phases unconditionally after the model is solved and
written to `<cfg>.out`:

1. the stand-alone ext-IO block (`IOTechParam` / `Extio`) — divides by
   `mem_data_width` / `num_clk` → **SIGFPE** when they are 0;
2. `solve_memcad` — dereferences an empty channel list → **SIGSEGV**.

Each is now guarded by `if (mem_data_width > 0 && num_dq > 0 && num_clk > 0)`.
These phases produce only auxiliary diagnostics and run *after* the model results
are computed and emitted, so the guards do not change any CACTI output — verified
by the byte-identical replays above (stock CACTI crashes on these configs before
this artifact's guards). The patches are visible in `io.cc`.

## Build

`setup.sh` builds CACTI with `make` into `external/cacti/` (via the PPA
characterization stage `data/ppa/generate_ppa.sh`; the `cacti` binary and
`obj_dbg/` objects are gitignored). Verified: `make -j$(nproc)` with
g++ 13.3.0 builds the `cacti` binary in well under a second on the 64-core
host; the replay above reproduces the recorded `.out` files exactly.
